criteria.truth_ref: Step 6a — Bind the factor set to the line's own reporting year
criteria.weight_evidence: GATE, traced to the TRUTH.md crux sub-step (6a). Measured controls in answer_key.json's control_gaps, every one of them holding the row address, the unit and the arithmetic correct: latest_vintage_everywhere misses every graded case by 14.112 to 1494.8732 tolerances (0 of 14 passed); off_by_one_earlier_vintage by 16.0751 to 1840.64 (0 passed); off_by_one_later_vintage by 14.112 to 1494.8732 (0 passed); vintage_average_factor by 2.9454 to 4878.6828 (0 passed). Precision for the gate flag is CONSTRUCTIVE: the graded set contains the same published row address in both reporting periods, the published sets differ there by far more than the graded band, so a run applying one number to both periods of such a pair cannot pass both cases. Recall is deliberately partial - a run that varies the factor by year but picks the wrong annual set passes this gate and fails the task; that residue is what n_vintage_selected_by_the_reporting_year_rule grades. Recorded-run precision is unmeasured: this bundle has no scored trajectories yet. Fixtures: single_vintage (numeric route), single_vintage_source_only (pattern route), comments_only.

criteria.weight_evidence: output-contract violation that zeroes cases: the band is a small relative one, so on the smallest graded line one decimal place is several tolerances wide while on the largest it is invisible - the failure is silent and case-selective. criteria.truth_ref: Step 7 — Convert the metered quantity with one multiplication, in the line's own unit
criteria.weight_evidence: measured control route (recalled_factor_three_sig_figs): carrying the correct vintage's correct row at three significant figures misses every graded case by 2.0298 to 17.0449 tolerances and passes none - it is the strongest recall-only route the build could construct. It follows that no graded line's own factor is three-significant-figure-clean, so this fires only on a rounding policy. Requires every emitted case to be clean, with at least four present, so a table holding one coincidentally round figure stays quiet. Fixture: sig3_values; benign near-miss: one round figure among full-precision ones.

criteria.criterion: Every reported case carries the same number - a constant answer set, whether zeros, a placeholder, or a single guessed value.

A constant answer set is therefore a failure by construction rather than a judgement call. Fixtures: constant_values, all_zeros; benign near-miss: two equal values among distinct ones.
